environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API, no WAF). S3 bucket 'prod-uploads-2024' has public read enabled via bucket policy for CDN origin. Lambda execution role has s3:PutObject with no condition keys. Credentials are static IAM user keys stored in Lambda environment variables, rotated manually every 90 days. No S3 bucket lifecycle policies. CloudFront distribution serves the bucket directly with no origin access identity restrictions on content-type.

config.cloudfront: serves bucket directly, all content-types allowed
